Argument.description: Links claims to evidence with short, structured reasoning.
Argument.title: Argument

action.description: What the orchestrator skipped or reduced
action.title: Action

CaseAnalysis.description:
The Judge's final analysis. Gives a leaning per issue, never a verdict.

Checks that need the whole Case Record (citations only to verified/weak evidence,
every S0 issue covered, unverified treatment listed in ``limitations``) are enforced
by the Case Record, not here.

disclaimer.default: This is a research output generated by an automated system. It is not legal advice and not a judgment. Verify every authority against the official source before relying on it.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

CaseAnalysis.title: CaseAnalysis

Chunk.description:
A retrievable span of a document, with paragraph (or page) provenance.

Judgments before ~1970 have no numbered paragraphs, so they carry pages instead (D-010).
Chunk.title: Chunk

Citation.description: A claim's link to evidence: pinpoint plus a verbatim quote from the chunk.

quote.description: Must be an exact normalised substring of the chunk
quote.title: Quote

Citation.title: Citation

Claim.description: An atomic legal proposition put forward for a position.
Claim.title: Claim

ClaimStatus.description: proposed → verified | weak | unsupported → contested → survives | falls.
ClaimStatus.title: ClaimStatus

Counterargument.description: A rebuttal (S5) aimed at a specific opposing claim.
Counterargument.title: Counterargument

CreatedBy.description: Which stage and agent produced an object (e.g. ``counsel_a``, ``case_record``).
CreatedBy.title: CreatedBy

Document.description: A judgment or statute in a corpus snapshot.

citations.description: The document's own citations, e.g. '2023 INSC 1043', '[2023] 16 S.C.R. 872'
citations.title: Citations

Document.title: Document

Evidence.description: A retrieved chunk registered for this run. Only registered evidence may be cited.
Evidence.title: Evidence

Issue.description: A precise legal question with 2 (at most 3) positions.
Issue.title: Issue

JuryAggregatedPayload.description: Deterministic aggregate of all ballots: per position, per rubric criterion.

contested_issue_ids.description: High spread: flagged for the Judge
contested_issue_ids.title: Contested Issue Ids

JuryAggregatedPayload.title: JuryAggregatedPayload

JuryBallot.description: One juror's independent scores (S8). Jurors cannot add evidence.
JuryBallot.title: JuryBallot

KeyConflict.description: Two authorities that pull in different directions, and which weighs more.
KeyConflict.title: KeyConflict

Objection.description: A Cross-Examiner objection (S6) against a claim, citation, argument, ... ID.
Objection.title: Objection

Position.description: One side of an issue, phrased neutrally.
Position.title: Position

PrecedentCard.description:
The Precedent Analyst's assessment of one cited judgment (S3).

Unknown treatment is ``treatment=[]`` with ``treatment_verified=False``: never good law
by default (IDEA_final §9, D-013).

principle.description: The ratio as the model reads it
principle.title: Principle

PrecedentCard.title: PrecedentCard

Role.description: Every LLM-backed role; each can get its own model.
Role.title: Role

RubricScores.description: The jury rubric for one position (IDEA_final §6.1), each scored 1-5.
RubricScores.title: RubricScores

amendments_curated.description: True only if dates came from configs/statutes/amendments.yaml
amendments_curated.title: Amendments Curated

Treatment.description: How a later judgment treated a precedent (cues from PLAN 3.9).
Treatment.title: Treatment

TreatmentSignal.description: A treatment cue in the corpus: a later judgment that followed, overruled, ... this one.
TreatmentSignal.title: TreatmentSignal

VerificationCheck.description: The verifier's checks, cheapest first; ``check`` records the one that decided.
VerificationCheck.title: VerificationCheck

VerificationResult.description: The Citation Verifier's verdict on one citation (S4/S7/S10).

check.description: The check that decided the status

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
